services.title: Network Design & Architecture
services.shortDescription: High-performance LAN/WAN topology planning, VLAN segmentation, and enterprise infrastructure blueprints built for resilience and scalability.
services.fullDescription: ABS Network engineers design robust network architectures that keep your business online and efficient. Our team plans LAN/WAN topologies, IP addressing, subnetting, and full VLAN architectures, with comprehensive documentation and mapping delivered at every stage.
services.imageAlt: Enterprise Network Architecture and Topology Planning
services.whatsappMessage: Hello ABS Network, I am interested in your Network Design & Architecture services. I would like to discuss my requirements.
services.seoTitle: Network Design & Architecture Services | ABS Network
services.seoDescription: Professional LAN/WAN design, VLAN segmentation, and enterprise network architecture engineered for resilience and scalability by ABS Network.

services.title: Office Network Installation
services.shortDescription: End-to-end office networking rollout including rack assembly, patch panel dressing, switch configuration, and certified cable testing.
services.fullDescription: Complete office network deployment handled by certified engineers. We install structured cabling, network racks, patch panels, and switches, then test and label every drop for a clean, reliable, and maintainable network.
services.imageAlt: Office Network Installation and Structured Rack Management
capabilities: Structured cabling, patch panels & rack setup
features: Structured cabling, patch panels & rack setup
services.whatsappMessage: Hello ABS Network, I need complete Office Network Installation and deployment support.

services.title: Internet Infrastructure & Multi-WAN
services.shortDescription: Redundant ISP connectivity, dedicated fiber links, automated failover, dynamic load balancing, and bandwidth queue management.
services.fullDescription: Zero-downtime internet begins with redundant connectivity. ABS Network designs multi-WAN internet infrastructure with automatic failover, load balancing, and bandwidth queue management so your business stays online even when a single link fails.
services.imageAlt: Enterprise Internet Infrastructure and Multi-WAN Failover
services.whatsappMessage: Hello ABS Network, I am interested in your Internet Infrastructure and Multi-WAN failover solutions.
services.seoTitle: Internet Infrastructure & Multi-WAN Solutions | ABS Network
services.seoDescription: Redundant ISP connectivity, dedicated fiber links, automated failover, and load balancing for zero-downtime enterprise internet.

services.title: Network Troubleshooting & Optimization
services.shortDescription: Fast diagnosis and root-cause resolution for packet loss, DNS issues, IP conflicts, Wi-Fi interference, and bottlenecked throughput.
services.fullDescription: When your network is slow or unstable, ABS Network engineers diagnose and resolve the root cause fast. We fix packet loss, DNS and DHCP issues, IP conflicts, Wi-Fi interference, and tune throughput and latency for peak performance.
capabilities: Packet loss, DNS & DHCP conflict debugging
features: Packet loss, DNS & DHCP conflict debugging
services.whatsappMessage: Hello ABS Network, I am facing network issues and need urgent network troubleshooting assistance.

services.title: Cisco Network Solutions
services.shortDescription: Certified configuration and management for Cisco Catalyst switches, ISR/ASR routers, Inter-VLAN routing, OSPF, ACLs, and port security.
services.fullDescription: Our certified engineers configure and manage Cisco Catalyst switches, ISR/ASR routers, VLANs, trucks, Inter-VLAN routing, static routing, OSPF, EIGRP, NAT, and ACLs. We also harden and optimize your Cisco environment for performance and security.
services.imageAlt: Cisco Router and Switch Enterprise Configuration
capabilities: VLANs, 802.1Q trunks, access ports & Inter-VLAN routing
Static routing, OSPF, EIGRP, NAT & ACL security
STP, Port Security, device hardening & maintenance
services.whatsappMessage: Hello ABS Network, I am interested in Cisco networking services and router/switch configuration.
services.seoDescription: Certified Cisco Catalyst switch and router configuration, Inter-VLAN routing, OSPF, ACLs, and port security from ABS Network engineers.

services.title: MikroTik Network Solutions
services.shortDescription: Expert RouterOS deployment for PPPoE servers, Hotspot gateways, multi-WAN PCC load balancing, VPN tunnels, and advanced firewall filters.
services.fullDescription: MikroTik is the backbone of cost-effective ISP and enterprise routing. ABS Network specializes in RouterOS configuration, PPPoE servers, hotspot portals, multi-WAN PCC load balancing, queue management, VPN tunnels, and firewall filter rules.
services.imageAlt: MikroTik RouterOS Configuration and Bandwidth Management
capabilities: Multi-WAN failover, PCC load balancing & policy routing
Queue tree bandwidth management & hotspot portals
services.whatsappMessage: Hello ABS Network, I am interested in MikroTik configuration and networking services.
services.seoDescription: Expert RouterOS configuration, PPPoE servers, multi-WAN PCC load balancing, VPN tunnels, and firewall filters by ABS Network.

services.title: Windows Server & Active Directory
services.shortDescription: Enterprise Windows Server setup, Domain Controller migration, Group Policy enforcement, File/Print servers, IIS, and Microsoft 365 hybrid sync.
services.fullDescription: Reliable Windows Server management keeps your business identity and file services running. ABS Network installs and migrates Windows Server, manages Active Directory Domain Services, enforces Group Policy, and configures DNS, DHCP, IIS, and Remote Desktop Services.

Group Policy Objects (GPO) security & access rights

shopProducts.name: ABS AX3000 Dual-Band Wi-Fi 6 Fiber Router
shopProducts.shortDescription: Dual-band Wi-Fi 6 router with gigabit fiber WAN passthrough for homes and small offices.
shopProducts.fullDescription: The ABS AX3000 delivers simultaneous 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz bands with GameFast QoS, gigabit LAN ports and a dedicated fiber WAN slot. Ideal as a gateway for ABS GPON fiber installations.

specifications.Standards: IEEE 802.11ax / ac / a / b / g / n

features: Fiber SFP WAN port for GPON gateways

shopProducts.name: ABS GPON ONT 1GE Optical Network Terminal
shopProducts.shortDescription: Single-port GPON ONT (Optical Network Terminal) with 1 GE port for FTTH broadband.
shopProducts.fullDescription: Compact GPON ONT providing true fiber-to-the-home connectivity with a single gigabit LAN port, low power consumption, and TR-069 remote management compatibility.

shopProducts.name: ABS 24-Port Gigabit Managed L2+ Switch
shopProducts.shortDescription: 24-port managed gigabit switch with 4 SFP uplinks for enterprise and ISP distribution.
shopProducts.fullDescription: Layer-2+ managed switch with full VLAN, QoS, link aggregation, and 4 combo SFP fiber uplinks. Ideal for MDUs, offices and ISP access-layer deployments.

shopProducts.name: ABS AC1200 Dual-Band Ceiling Access Point
shopProducts.shortDescription: 802.11ac dual-band ceiling access point with PoE for offices and MDUs.
shopProducts.fullDescription: PoE-powered ceiling access point delivering up to 1200 Mbps, 802.3af PoE, and centralized controller support — suited for offices, hotels and multi-dwelling units.

shopProducts.name: ABS Cat6 UTP LAN Cable (305 m Box)
shopProducts.shortDescription: Category 6 UTP bulk cable, 24 AWG, PVC jacket, 305 m pull box — certified for Gigabit runs.
shopProducts.fullDescription: High-performance Cat6 UTP cable engineered for Gigabit Ethernet and PoE deployments, with 23-24 AWG solid copper conductors and reduced crosstalk for reliable structured cabling.

shopProducts.name: ABS Single-Mode SC-SC Fiber Patch Cord (2 m)
shopProducts.shortDescription: G.652D single-mode duplex fiber patch cord with SC connectors, 2 m — for ONT and switch links.
shopProducts.fullDescription: Low-loss G.652D single-mode patch cord terminated with SC/UPC connectors, ideal for ONT-to-router, patch panel and switch interconnects in fiber networks.

shopProducts.name: ABS Fiber Connector & Adapter Kit (SC/LC)
shopProducts.shortDescription: Field termination kit with SC/LC connectors, adapters, and cleaning tools for fiber splicing and patching.
shopProducts.fullDescription: Complete accessory set for terminating and joining fiber — SC and LC connectors, duplex adapters, caps, and cleaning accessories for maintenance teams and home installs.

shopProducts.name: ABS 48V PoE Power Adapter (802.3af/at)
shopProducts.shortDescription: Single-port 802.3af/at PoE injector/adapter (48 V) for access points, cameras and switches.
shopProducts.fullDescription: Compact PoE power adapter injecting 48 V @ 30 W to a single network port — powers access points, IP cameras, and small switches without a PoE switch.

shopProducts.name: ABS Wi-Fi 7 Dual-Band Fiber Gateway
shopProducts.shortDescription: Next-generation Wi-Fi 7 dual-band gateway tuned for 2.5 Gbps fiber plans and heavy multi-device homes.
shopProducts.fullDescription: The ABS GW-WIFI7 brings Wi-Fi 7 multi-link operation to residential fiber with a 2.5 GbE WAN/LAN port, MU-MIMO and OFDMA scheduling, plus a dedicated gaming priority queue. Pairs natively with ABS GPON ONTs.
features: 2.5 GbE WAN port for high-tier fiber

shopProducts.name: TP-Link Archer AX55 AX3000 Wi-Fi 6 Router
shopProducts.shortDescription: AX3000 dual-band Wi-Fi 6 router with gigabit ports — a proven upgrade for fiber homes.
shopProducts.fullDescription: The TP-Link Archer AX55 delivers AX3000 speeds across 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz with OFDMA, four gigabit LAN ports and robust home coverage. Includes TP-Link HomeShield security and easy app control.
features: TP-Link app setup and VPN client

shopProducts.name: ABS 4G/LTE Failover Router for Fiber Backup
shopProducts.shortDescription: Automatic 4G/LTE failover router that keeps business lines alive if fiber drops.
shopProducts.fullDescription: Dual-WAN router with a built-in 4G/LTE modem that automatically fails over to cellular when the fiber uplink goes down. Gigabit Ethernet WAN, dual antennas and remote SIM management for business continuity.
features: Business continuity for shops and offices

shopProducts.name: ABS 8-Port Gigabit PoE+ Managed Switch
shopProducts.shortDescription: 8-port gigabit switch with 8x PoE+ (120 W budget) for cameras, APs and IP phones.
shopProducts.fullDescription: Managed L2 switch offering 8 gigabit ports with 802.3at/af PoE+ injection and a 120 W budget — ideal for powering access points and CCTV on small business networks. Web/CLI managed with VLAN and QoS.
features: Rack and wall mounting kit included

shopProducts.name: Ubiquiti UniFi Switch Lite 8 PoE
shopProducts.shortDescription: 8-port PoE UniFi switch managed from the UniFi Network console — perfect for UniFi AP fleets.
shopProducts.fullDescription: Silent, fanless UniFi Switch Lite 8 PoE powers UniFi access points and cameras, managed centrally from the UniFi Network application. Four PoE+ ports, 52 W budget and a 1 Gbps SFP uplink.

shopProducts.name: Huawei MA5671A GPON ONT Stick
shopProducts.shortDescription: SFP-class GPON ONT module that turns any SFP router/switch port into a fiber WAN.
shopProducts.fullDescription: The Huawei MA5671A plugs directly into an SFP port and terminates a GPON line without an external ONT. A favorite of power users and ISPs for replacing carrier ONTs on advanced routers.
features: Bridges GPON into an SFP slot

shopProducts.name: ABS GPON Home Gateway Wi-Fi 6 ONT
shopProducts.shortDescription: All-in-one GPON ONT with built-in Wi-Fi 6 router, 4 gigabit LAN ports and voice capability.
shopProducts.fullDescription: A compact FTTH gateway combining a GPON ONT, a Wi-Fi 6 access point and a 4-port gigabit router. Includes OMCI/TR-069 management and wall-mount housing — ideal for single-box fiber installs.
features: GPON ONT, router and Wi-Fi in one

shopProducts.name: ABS Cat6 RJ45 Patch Leads (10-Pack, 1 m)
shopProducts.shortDescription: Ten 1 m Cat6 snagless patch leads with 24 AWG stranded copper for patching racks and desks.
shopProducts.fullDescription: Stranded 24 AWG Cat6 patch cords with snagless boots and gold-plated RJ45 contacts. Certified to 250 MHz for gigabit and PoE patching between switches, panels and endpoints.

shopProducts.name: ABS Cat5e UTP Bulk Cable (305 m Box)
shopProducts.shortDescription: Cat5e UTP bulk cable in a 305 m box — economical Gigabit-rated cabling for homes and offices.
shopProducts.fullDescription: Reliable Cat5e UTP bulk cable, 24 AWG solid copper, PVC jacket, in a 305 m pull box. Fully Gigabit and PoE capable, ideal for low-cost structured cabling and long patch-run projects.

shopProducts.name: ABS OM3 LC-LC Duplex Fiber Patch Cord (3 m)
shopProducts.shortDescription: OM3 laser-optimized multimode duplex patch cord, LC-LC, 3 m — ready for 10G fiber links.
shopProducts.fullDescription: Laser-optimized OM3 multimode fiber with low-loss LC/UPC connectors. Purpose-built for 10 Gigabit Ethernet to 300 m and ideal for switch-to-panel patching in data centers and MDUs.

shopProducts.name: ABS Armored Single-Mode Drop Cable (1 km)
shopProducts.shortDescription: Steel-armored G.652D single-mode drop cable with messenger — field-proven for FTTH outdoor drops.
shopProducts.fullDescription: G.652D fiber with steel armor and a messenger wire for aerial FTTH drops, plus a 3 mm breakout for indoor termination. Supplied on a 1 km drum with sequential length markings for installers and ISPs.

shopProducts.name: ABS Fiber Splice Closure & Tray Kit
shopProducts.shortDescription: Weatherproof splice closure with 6 splice trays, holders and protection sleeves for FTTH splicing.
shopProducts.fullDescription: In-line splice closure (up to 12 fibers) with gel-sealed ports, a splice tray organizer and heat-shrink protection sleeves — everything a technician needs for outdoor FTTH splices.

shopProducts.name: ABS Cat6 Keystone Jack + Faceplate Kit
shopProducts.shortDescription: Cat6 shielded keystone jack with wall faceplate and punch-down tool set for tidy wall drops.
shopProducts.fullDescription: Complete wall-outlet kit: a Cat6 tool-less/shielded keystone jack, single-gang faceplate, wall screws and a mini punch-down tool. Produces clean, rattle-free wall terminations on structured cabling.

shopProducts.name: ABS RJ45 Crimping & Termination Tool Kit
shopProducts.shortDescription: Professional RJ45/RJ11 crimper with stripper, cutter and tester — the installer's standard kit.
shopProducts.fullDescription: All-in-one crimping kit for RJ45/RJ11 plugs, including a ratchet crimper, cable stripper, cutting tool, 50 connectors and a handy canvas pouch. The go-to kit for cable termination jobs.

shopProducts.name: ABS Optical Power Meter + VFL Tester
shopProducts.shortDescription: Calibrated optical power meter with 10 mW visual fault locator for FTTH install and repair.
shopProducts.fullDescription: Dual-function OPM/VFL tester measuring 850/1300/1310/1490/1550 nm and locating breaks with a 10 mW red laser. Backlit LCD, auto-power-off and rechargeable battery for field technicians.
features: Backlit LCD and auto power off

shopProducts.name: ABS OTDR Fiber Analyzer (1310/1550 nm)
shopProducts.shortDescription: Touchscreen OTDR with 1310/1550 nm lasers, event analysis and integrated OPM/VFL for fiber commissioning.
shopProducts.fullDescription: Professional OTDR measuring single-mode networks with dynamic range up to 40 dB, automatic event map (loss, reflectance, events, sections) and a 7-inch touchscreen — built for FTTH and metro fiber commissioning.

shopProducts.name: ABS 12U Wall-Mount Server Rack Cabinet
shopProducts.shortDescription: 12U ventilated wall-mount cabinet with glass door for MDU and office equipment corners.
shopProducts.fullDescription: Wall-mount 19-inch cabinet (12U) with a tempered glass front door, ventilated sides, removable panels and a built-in patch slot. Holds switches, ONTs and small patch panels securely out of the way.
features: 400 mm depth suits switches + patch panels

shopProducts.name: ABS 24-Port Shielded Cat6 Patch Panel (1U)
shopProducts.shortDescription: 1U 24-port shielded Cat6 punch-down patch panel with rear cable bar for tidy racks.
shopProducts.fullDescription: 24-port Cat6 FTP patch panel in a 1U steel frame with a rear cable manager and numbered front ports. Punch-down (110/Krone) termination with clear labels for structured cabling.

shopProducts.name: ABS 1U Horizontal Cable Manager (D-Ring)
shopProducts.shortDescription: 1U D-ring horizontal cable manager that keeps patch leads neat between panels and switches.
shopProducts.fullDescription: Steel 1U horizontal cable management panel with D-rings and spring-loaded covers for tidy front patching. Protects leads from snags and maintains bends at the correct radius.

shopProducts.name: ABS Gigabit Media Converter Kit (SC, MM)
shopProducts.shortDescription: Copper-to-fiber gigabit media converter kit with SC multimode port for long building runs.
shopProducts.fullDescription: A matched pair of 10/100/1000 media converters (plus power supplies) extends copper LAN runs over multimode fiber via SC connectors to 550 m. Plug-and-play with no configuration.
